comments.mergedPostDetails:
The current brightness of the gesture indicators came off as a little distracting at first. While one can get used to them over time, they will still be way too apparent on recordings, especially to other viewers. The opacity of the indicators can be reduced to 70% or 80% to make them less distracting.

This was found to be a duplicate of the following posts:
https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1216-allow-gesture-indicator-to-have-custom-opacity
https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1216-gesture-indicator-transparency-and-fade-out
Give them a vote as well.

comments.mergedPostDetails:
# Issue:
The current Icons for the Gesture Indicator feel a bit out of place and do not fit with the rest of the game, they are also way to intrusive.
# Suggestion:
1. Replace the icons with a more simplistic outline, maybe take a look at the ones Moon used for his Avatar based Gesture Indicator: https://twitter.com/MOONVRCHAT/status/1552173671959216128?s=20&t=ajPCYY66FepBJ28320q8iQ 
2. Make them transparent, that way they aren’t just two big white blobs on your screen.
3. Add a “Gesture Indicator Fadeout” Toggle, some people only want to see the Indicator for a few seconds after doing a Gesture, some others want to see it the whole time. With a toggle, both people are happy.

The gesture indicator is nice, but currently when you do a gesture and then lock your gestures, the hand icon shows up on your screen forever afterwards showing the gesture you're doing. 
If I want do a happy face ^^ with my hand open., and I then gesture lock it so I have it on for a few minutes, I don't want the hand open gesture icon to also be showing up the entire time in my field of vision.

details:
This is a partial duplicate of the following feature with an additional request:
https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1216-allow-gesture-indicator-to-have-custom-opacity
Currently Gesture Indicator is fully opaque and is permenantly on. Unlike the microphone icon, it does not have transparency, and unlike the gesture lock, it does not fade out. This makes it jarring against the UI, and means it is always there. Quite often users only want a glance to see their gesture worked and then for it to dissapear and get out of the way. 
I did my own implementation of this via OSC and a SteamVR overlay here, as an example of what I personally would like: https://twitter.com/MeroFune/status/1553121845867577344
title: [1216] Gesture Indicator Transparency and Fade-Out
